title: I made a mini-game about a hair salon
author: AggroSolo
selftext:
The original intention of creating this game was to use AI to produce some interesting things. The finished product looks very simple,but I think it's not easy to achieve the desired effect using AI.

**The key points in creating this game are:**

1.The differences in effects before and after actions such as combing hair,curling hair,and wetting hair.

2.I have a customer expression in the upper right corner of the game.The curvature of the lips changes in accordance with the user's satisfaction level. Currently, it is a bit difficult for the AI's instructions to achieve this effect.

Do you have any good solutions for these two key issues? For example,the optimization of the prompt words.

comments.author: Mysterious_Gold3137
comments.body: I have to say, I think you might be aiming for a more complex, life-sim-style game. However, creating a game like that with 2D graphics might be quite challenging, requiring a significant amount of 3D modeling to achieve the desired level of detail. Based on this video, the gameplay seems rather basic.

replies.author: AggroSolo
replies.body: The gameplay is indeed quite basic,but the challenge lies in the refinement of details and authenticity.

comments.author: Mysterious_Gold3137
comments.body: Using tools like scissors or brushes instead of circles when marking may be a more effective approach.

replies.author: AggroSolo
replies.body: Got it! We already have scissors,but we still don't have curling irons,hair dryers,or combs. These would make it more immersive for the users.

comments.author: Kiko_Production
comments.body: Reminds me one of TocaBoca games

replies.author: AggroSolo
replies.body: Which one? Could you provide the case? I‘d like to refer to it.
